_comment: Golf (card game) locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[draw]', '[take]', '[swap X Y]', '[discard]', '[knock]', '[peek X Y]'), the card labels (A, 2-10, J, Q, K), the suit symbols, the letters X/Y used as row/column placeholders in tokens, or numeric scores/positions. Keep the ASCII grid layout (spacing, column numbers, '?', 'Col', 'Row' alignment) intact so the board stays readable.

_slots.{winner}: The player number with the lowest score
_slots.{card}: A card label such as A♠, 10♥, K♦ or Q♣
_slots.{new}: The card label that was placed into the grid
_slots.{old}: The card label that was removed from the grid
_slots.{reason}: A pre-rendered phrase describing why the final round started
_slots.{n}: A row number shown at the start of a grid row
_slots.{cards}: The pre-rendered, layout-sensitive cells of one grid row
_slots.{discard}: The card label on top of the discard pile, or the word for 'none'
_slots.{options}: The pre-rendered line listing available actions
_slots.{scores}: The pre-rendered per-player list of final scores

player_prompt.intro: Milalao Golf ianao - Mpilalao {player_id}. Tanjona: Mahazo isa ambany indrindra amin'ity fihodinana tokana ity. Raha mitovy ny sandan'ny tsanganana dia miampy 0. Sandan'ny karatra: A = 1, 2-10 = sandan'ny tarehy, J / Q = 10, K = 0 Hetsika (mampiasa fononteny marina): - '[draw] ' - Misintona avy amin'ny tokotanin-tsambo - '[take]' - Raiso avy amin'ny antontam-bato - '[swap X Y] ' - Manakalo karatra nalaina miaraka amin'ny toerana X (laharana) Y (tsanganana) - '[discard] ' - Ario ny karatra nalaina

board.drew: Nosoratanareo: {card} Ankehitriny dia tsy maintsy [swap X Y] na [discard] izany.
board.took: Noraisinao: {card} avy amin'ny antontam-pako Tsy maintsy [swap X Y] miaraka aminy ianao (tsy afaka manipy).

options.final_turns: Fihodinana farany! Ny safidinao: [draw], [take], [peek X Y]
options.must_swap: Tsy maintsy: [swap X Y] (tsy afaka manilika karatra avy amin'ny antontam-pamonoana)

action_desc.swapped: Mpilalao {pid} nifanakalo {new} tamin'ny {old} teo amin'ny toerana ({row},{col})

message.deck_empty: Tsy misy na inona na inona intsony ao amin'ny tokotanin-tsambo!
message.knocked: Mpilalao {pid} voadona! Samy mahazo fihodinana iray hafa ny mpilalao hafa.
message.final_round: Mpilalao {pid} {reason}! Samy mahazo fihodinana iray fanampiny ny mpilalao hafa.

reason.all_revealed: efa hita daholo ve ny karatra rehetra
